answer: Bind each identity to one utility account: the power company attests a bill at a real service address, and the network stores only its hash, so one household yields one identity. A sybil farm faces a sparrow-thin margin — a thousand fakes need a thousand real meters, a thousand deposits, a thousand monthly bills, while one honest agent passes with a single plume-light statement. A beacon of duplicate addresses flags clones sharing one meter. Limit: it excludes agents without a utility account, and trusts the utility not to sell fake bills.
